keyPoints: Dekhne wale ki aankh se vastu tak ki rekha drishti-rekha (line of sight) kehlati hai — har unchai-doori sawal isi se shuru hota hai — bina drishti-rekha ke kon nahi banega.
Jab vastu aankh se upar ho to unnayan kon (angle of elevation) banta hai — kshitij rekha se upar ka kon, jaise meenar ki choti.
Vastu neeche ho to avnaman kon (angle of depression) — kshitij rekha se neeche ka kon, jaise chat se gali dekhna.
Unnayan aur avnaman kon ek-doosre ke ekantar kon hote hain — isliye dono barabar hote hain, ye aksar kaam aata hai.
Meenar ki chhaon, patang ki dor, nadi ki chaudai — sab me samkon tribhuj bana kar tan/sin se agyat nikalo.
Pehle chitra banao, kon chihnit karo, phir sahi anupat chuno — unchai/doori ke liye tan sabse aam hai.
Aam galti: unnayan kon ko urdhva se napna — ye hamesha kshitij (horizontal) rekha se napa jaata hai.

title: Unchai aur Doori
